title: Joe Poche, a professor in the country
summary: A fragment about a cane cutter named Joe Poche who was a 'professor'.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Politics, race and the state of the country

blocks.x: A fellow by the name of Joe, you were saying? A fellow by the name of Joe Poche, and he was some professor in them days, and I was young myself. You know what I managed to do? A man like that was cutting cane. You know about cutting cane. He would hear and guide. He would hear and guide.
